strapiBlog.title: Community Living in Dubai: What’s It Like?

data.text:
Let’s be honest, we know that Dubai is the best place to holiday in, but to live here, is a whole different treat!

Residents of Dubai will tell you that this city is just a gift that keeps giving. Anything under the sun, you can get here. Even when you look for a place to live, Dubai has so many options to choose from, be it apartments, villas, townhouses, penthouses, mansions, and more.

In Dubai, a community lifestyle is held in high regard. People in Dubai look at a community lifestyle for a sense of security, togetherness, and neighbourliness. A community is where families grow, friendships are formed and memories are made. This is why developers in the region concentrate and prioritise the creation of a great community, catering to individuals, young couples, and families.

As a resident of Dubai, when you go out to choose a place to live, a lot of factors come into play. The place where you work, medical facilities, schools, amenities and more. Consequently, the developers in the region have a good understanding of this. The major developers being Emaar, Meraas, Dubai Properties, Damac & Nakheel, each of them has created the most popular communities in the region. They have crafted each of these communities in areas with great connectivity, So what are some of the things that constitute a good community? Let’s have a closer look:

  • Proximity to schools & medical facilities
  • Retail & supermarket options
  • Child-friendliness
  • Pet-friendliness
  • Greenery & Open Spaces
  • Privacy
  • Access to major roadways
  • Proximity to iconic landmarks
  • Size of apartments/villas
  • Amenities for families and individuals
  • Beach Access
  • Playgrounds & Play Areas for Kids
  • Barbecue Areas
  • Swimming Pools for adults and kids
  • Parks & Walkways
  • Cycling & Jogging Tracks
  • Club Houses for adults and kids
  • Cinema Halls
  • Multipurpose Rooms
  • Gymnasiums & Fitness Centres

When we look at all the communities around Dubai, we will see that all of them tick all the boxes above.

These developers have gone a step ahead and have created amazing social events for all the neighbours to get to know each other. They celebrate all the major festivals and days of the year like NYE, Halloween, Eid, Diwali, Christmas, National Day, Happiness Day, Earth Day and more. In addition to these, there are also regular carnivals and talent hunts for kids, workshops for fire drills, winter wonderland, open-air cinema screening and more. Now, doesn’t that sound like an exciting way to live?

So, if you love a fast-paced life, maybe Downtown and Marina is your ideal place. If it is tranquility you are after, perhaps Arabian Ranches is your best bet. Here is a list of communities that are perfect for you, depending on your lifestyle:

  • Dubai Marina
  • Jumeirah Beach Residences
  • Palm Jumeirah
  • Emirates Living
  • Arabian Ranches
  • Damac Hills
  • Dubai Hills Estate
  • Port de la Mer
  • Bluewaters
  • Dubai Creek Harbour

No matter what your needs are from a community, Dubai has you covered. As the property market grows over the next couple of years, more and more communities are forming with a strong inclination towards family-centric areas and places that offer numerous amenities. As an individual, couple or family, this city is a place that has a home for everyone. So many options, & can’t decide where are you going to live?
